items.title: Patrick Stewart dies at 86
items.summary: Patrick Stewart, Star Trek's Captain Picard and X-Men's Professor X, died after a brief illness with Alzheimer's and Lewy body dementia, his account announced. Ian McKellen and William Shatner led the tributes, and fans shared old "Make it so" memes.
